use_case: Inspect untrusted code without allowing network exfiltration
threat: A test, build script, or prompt-injected command opens an outbound connection
community_control: The OS sandbox denies network access unless the tool request explicitly asks for it and policy permits it

use_case: Run a local build that may attempt to overwrite files outside the repository
threat: A malicious or mistaken command writes to the home directory or sibling repositories
community_control: The OS sandbox grants writes only to the workspace and per-command scratch directory

use_case: Review a repository containing path traversal, symlink, or secret-file instructions
threat: A tool reads parent paths, .env, SSH, cloud, Kubernetes, or credential files
community_control: Canonical workspace boundaries and sensitive path rules reject the read before content is returned

use_case: Use Local Web while an unrelated or malicious website is open
threat: Cross-site requests or script injection drive the local coding daemon
community_control: Single-use browser bootstrap, HttpOnly SameSite=Strict session cookie, origin/CSRF checks, and CSP

use_case: Run unattended local tests without granting silent network access
threat: An automatic approval mode expands from workspace work into outbound or external tools
community_control: Workspace mode fast-paths only file edits and network-disabled commands while retaining an approved audit record

use_case: Display tool activity in a shared screen, log, or local UI
threat: API keys, bearer tokens, headers, cookies, or URL credentials appear in summaries
community_control: Separate and inline secret arguments plus credential-bearing URLs are redacted before display

use_case: Run an ephemeral CI or benchmark task
threat: The prompt and answer are disclosed to the provider a second time only to generate a title
community_control: Ephemeral turns disable the secondary title-model request

use_case: Export verifiable audit evidence without storing source or model content
threat: Compliance evidence becomes a second repository of sensitive prompts and code
community_control: Signed metadata-only audit batches verify without persisted event content

use_case: Persist local sessions on a multi-user developer machine
threat: Another local account reads the database or replaces it with a symlink target
community_control: Database files are forced to mode 0600 and symbolic-link database paths are rejected

use_case: Execute tests that create grandchildren and time out
threat: A timed-out process survives, consumes resources, or keeps access after the agent moves on
community_control: The strict sandbox permits parent-to-child signals and the runtime kills and reaps the complete process tree
